title: Find Minimum in a Rotated Sorted Array
description: Given the sorted rotated array `nums` of unique elements, return the minimum element of this array in O(log n) time.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.

sample_tests.explanation: Array is not rotated (or rotated n times).

hints: If nums[mid] > nums[r], the minimum must be in the right half (mid + 1 to r).
Otherwise, the minimum is in the left half including mid.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    l, r = 0, n - 1
    while l < r:
        mid = (l + r) // 2
        if nums[mid] > nums[r]: l = mid + 1
        else: r = mid
    print(nums[l])
